app.title: SongTheSame
app.tagline: Five songs a day. Name them, then find their twins.

home.how1: Listen to a short clip and name the song. Each miss unlocks a longer clip.
home.how2: Then find another song that contains the part most similar to a segment of the one you just guessed.
home.how3: Five rounds a day, up to 500 points. Compare with other players and share your result.

phase1.title: Which song is this?
phase1.hint: Every miss unlocks a longer clip.

phase2.title: Find its twin
phase2.hint: Name another song that contains the part most similar to this segment. Tempo and key don't matter.

report.title: Report this score
report.description: Do you think the picked song contains a part that sounds like the segment, but the score doesn't show it? Tell us and we'll take a look.
